<thought>To find the template that performs the nitro‑to‑amine reduction, I will search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates where a nitro group is broken and an amine group is formed in the forward reaction. This should return the relevant template(s) with their IDs, from which I can obtain the mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(Cl)(=O)C1=CC(F)=CC=C1.Nc1ccc2c(c1)C(CCC3(CCC3)O3)=C(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)C2=CC=CC=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["nitro"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
